# Hat fittings

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/hats.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Where each hat sits on each Warrior. `CfgHat(set, type, hat, {x, y, z}, {i, j, k, r})` adds one fitting to a hat-fit
set, a 0xa90-byte record at `0x00662b70 + set × 0xa90` with 48 hat slots, owned by one character type. When a human
whose class has brain kind 3 (the Warriors) wears a hat, the hat is placed by the set of the type it was created as
(human `+0xd0`), else by the set of its class (`+0xcc`), at the fitting whose name is the hat's; every other human
uses the hat model's own attach point (`0x003a3ba0`). The hats are [objects](objects.md);
[Characters: hats](../research/characters.md#hats).

!!! info "What is complete"

    All 908 fittings of `config_preload2.lua` are listed: 28 sets, one per Warriors model, 14 to 43 hats each. A hat that
    is in no slot of a wearer's set gets a default transform. No hat thumbnails are rendered yet.

908 entries. Data: `research/references/hats.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `<type>:<hat>`. |
| `wearer` | str | | The character type and model the set is looked up by. |
| `set` | int | | Hat-fit set (`CfgHat`'s first argument; record `0x00662b70 + set x 0xa90`). |
| `type` | int | | Character type the set belongs to (record `+0xa80`). |
| `hat` | str | | The hat [object](objects.md). |
| `pos` | list | | Offset `{x, y, z}` in metres from the head. |
| `rot` | list | | Rotation quaternion `{i, j, k, r}`. |
| `image` | str | | A thumbnail, a path below `docs/references/images/` (`characters/warr_re_cv.png`); set by extract from the files present. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
